art_instructions: Draw a low-angle, wide shot of a child-sized, green dinosaur standing alone in the family house, with a sad expression on his face. The dinosaur should be positioned in the center of the frame, with the wooden walls and furniture of the house visible in the background. The dinosaur's big, expressive eyes should be looking down, and his short tail should be hung low, conveying his sadness. The lighting should be warm and natural, with a slight vignette to focus attention on the dinosaur. The color palette should feature warm brown, soft green, and cream, with the dinosaur's smooth pea-green scales and pale mint belly standing out. The background should be simple, with minimal details, and the furniture should be low and welcoming, with soft green cushions and cream-colored curtains adding comfort. The dinosaur should be the main focus of the image, with plenty of negative space around him to emphasize his isolation and sadness.
